tool_args.rationale: The five observations at one fixed x_now, mem_conv, s_grad, and H are consistent with a saturating response, but do not identify whether it is the cited snapshot recruitment law or the hinted two-hop mobility bridge. The targeted open-branch probe is the lowest-cost discriminating observation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a present-snapshot Beverton–Holt law to the five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot only varies u_now; it cannot distinguish that saturating snapshot mechanism from a temporal mobility bridge that also produces saturation.
More points along the same apparent response curve are less informative than opening the branch that distinguishes the candidate mechanisms.
It is not relevant to resolving the identified mechanism ambiguity.
